newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Bank to sell Raffles, RCHL shares.
newsitem.headline: DBS Bank to sell Raffles, RCHL shares.

text.p: DBS Bank said on Friday it had entered a conditional agreement with DBS Land Ltd to sell shares in Raffles City (Pte) Ltd (RCPL) and RC Hotels (Pte) Ltd (RCHL) for a profit of at least Singapore $170 million.
DBS Bank said in a statement it would sell 68.0 million shares representing 12.87 percent of RCPL and 1.3 million shares representing 12.87 percent of RCHL to wholly-owned subsidiaries of DBS Land.
The sale would be related to the previously announced plan of DBS Land to list Raffles Holdings (1995) Pte Ltd on the Stock Exchange of Singapore.

The exact consideration for the sale would be determined at the time of the proposed IPO, but DBS said it expected a profit of at least S$170 million, which would be treated as an extraordinary gain. The completion of the sale was expected to place after the financial year ending December 31, 1996, DBS Bank said.
